description.text: A special Sword & Shield set based on the mobile game Pokémon GO, released on 1 July 2022 with 88 cards: 78 and 10 secret rares, and sold only in special collections. It has Dragonite VSTAR, Mewtwo VSTAR and Gigantamax Melmetal VMAX, Radiant Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise, and the leaders of Team Instinct, Team Mystic and Team Valor, and codes from its packs could be redeemed in Pokémon GO for items.

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Pokémon Trading Card Game sets
